g.text: MarieRank1Convo4 begins.
May I ask what I hope is not an impolite question ? It is so very early in our friendship, especially to you, who by the tell of it, have known so many years.
I've honestly forgotten most of the years I've known.
Of course, I don't mind. Go ahead.
[End.]
Sol ! You break my heart with your words. You and the devil both find your minds devoid of knowledge like a book with chapters removed, non ?
+5 Chemistry
Chat ends.
I don't miss the parts of my past I'm lacking.
If for very different reasons, yes.
Evaluate expressions on HellKeyPlayed
Truly ? It seems then you are the only one who does not. Between the child and the devil, it seems all are seeking parts of themselves they have misplaced.
Is it too much of me to ask why you find yourself so bereft ? The child and the devil's reasons are known to me, but not yours.
Why have you agreed to help the devil in his endeavors ? I hear tell you are responsible for the slaughter of his kin.
Do you intend to assist the devil in his endeavors ? I hear tell you are responsible for the slaughter of his kin.
false
I have spent some unknown number of years dying at the hands of... well? Myself. I don't mind not being able to remember each one.
To summarize, I spent... a great number of years suffering. I guess it's some kind of self-defense mechanism, to forget.
That was my other self. I believe in holding blame to individuals, not societies.
That wasn't me, that was the kid. But I hate the Orokin just as much as the kid does.
I wasn't there, the Night of the Naga Drums, when the Tenno turned on the Orokin. That was the kid.
Nor do I blame you. If I were subject to that manner of abuse, I would be eager enough to tuck it all away. At the very least, I would not go looking for it.
I have no doubt ! If I were subject to that manner of abuse, I expect my soul would do something similar. Hide away all that cannot be mended, and does no good.
Add 1 to Thermostat
Add -1 to Thermostat
Night of the Naga Drums. Oh, I can see it in my mind. Quelles couleurs magnifiques !
+5 Chemistry
Oui, je comprends. So quick we are to burn the building down, when the smell is the fault of the rats within its walls.
Je meurs d'envie de savoir pourquoi ! But a conversation for another day. Or else we will be here forever, and Monsieur Loid will become cross with me.
I will need to speak to Monsieur Loid for more details. But !
Although, this may give me some insight over what I wished to speak with you.
But that is a conversation for another day, or else we will be here forever, and Monsieur Loid will become cross with me.
Evaluate expressions on HellKeyPlayed
Pardonnez-moi ! I am not giving you a chance to answer. Why lend aid to the devil, then ?
Pardonnez-moi ! I am not giving you a chance to answer. Will you lend aid to the devil, then ?
false
He hasn't done anything to prove he isn't worth helping... yet.
I don't think I can be in the business of turning away allies.
[Confess interest in Roathe.] There's something compelling about him...
He seems like he's doing what he needs to survive. I can't fault him for that.
Add 1 to Thermostat
Update boolean MarieRoatheSoldier
Update boolean DrifterRoathe
Add -1 to Thermostat
+5 Chemistry
Ah, I see. You are simply in the business of collecting soldiers. But that devil would sooner sink a dagger betwixt your ribs than guard your back.
Le diable séduit les cœurs les plus forts. He plays the cunning game, but be careful. Make sure he meets your eye and nothing else.
Seems to me he has survived for longer than anyone should. I think perhaps hell should come reclaim its own, it seems to have wandered off.
I laud your compassion, it fills my heart with joy. The Luminaries teach us that all can be given aid. All can be forgiven. But... only if they seek it.
He is no ally of yours, nor will he ever be. That devil sides only with those who serve his needs.
+5 Chemistry
Endless toil aiding those who never sweat in the field of their own redemption is the life of a slave left wanting.
I know more about the Orokin and his situation than you. I don't need your help.
I appreciate your warnings. I'll keep them in mind when I'm dealing with him.
Thank you. But I can handle myself. And, more importantly? I have handled worse than him.
But I am being unkind... you do not know him. You do not see him for what he is. I simply do not wish for you to be hurt.
Update boolean MarieRoatheWarning
+10 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
Pardon. I hardly know you or your capacity for withstanding manipulation. I merely worry, as we have heaped our woes upon you.
That is all I could ask. Merci, merci, merci. Now, I fear I must go.
Oui, vous avez raison. I hardly know you or your capacity for withstanding manipulation. I merely worry, as we have heaped our woes upon you.
I shall not overstep again.
Chat ends.
And now, I fear I must go.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
